segments.comment: Independent pline.c vpline() witness for MSGTYPE=stop on an urgent impossible() line: #wizloaddes of a missing file leaves mkmaze.c put_lregion_here() no room, so impossible() prints 'Couldn't place lregion type 3!' with URGENT_MESSAGE. tty_putstr() clears its one-shot WIN_NOSTOP before vpline() waits for the stop type, so Escape at that --More-- sets WIN_STOP and hides the following 'Program in disorder!' lines until the next urgent impossible() message.
